# HELP mock_server_response_write_stalls_total Responses cut because their client took none of what was waiting for it for responseWriteStallTimeoutMillis, by protocol (http1_1, http2, http3, tunnel, websocket, other) and scope (connection: the connection was closed; stream: one HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 stream was reset)
# TYPE mock_server_response_write_stalls_total counter
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="http1_1",scope="connection"} 0.0
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="http2",scope="connection"} 0.0
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="http2",scope="stream"} 1.0
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="http3",scope="stream"} 0.0
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="other",scope="connection"} 0.0
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="tunnel",scope="connection"} 0.0
mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol="websocket",scope="connection"} 0.0
results.note: stream 1 reset alone: stream 3 was given a fresh period, so for a period the count stays at one (resetting both in one check would jump from 0 to 2)
stream 1's data, then RST_STREAM CANCEL for stream 1 and, a period later, for stream 3
